claims.population: The article gives a population of 777,667 at the 2006 census.
claims.climate: The article gives a tropical savanna climate (Aw) with annual rainfall of 990.3 to 1,318 mm and March as the hottest month.
claims.pottery: The article says pottery is a major business, with the biggest traditional pottery workshops in Nigeria in Okelele, Oju-Ekun, Okekura, Oloje, Abe Emi and Ita Merin.
claims.textile: The article says aso-oke, textiles hand-woven on simple looms, is made in large quantities in Ilorin.
claims.industry: The article names Global Soap, Detergent Industries Nigeria Limited, the International Tobacco Company and Dangote Flour Mills among Kwara industrial companies.
